column1: # pgflow-upgrade reads this to recognise databases created before images wrote the "pgflow X.Y.Z" schema comment.
# Columns: structure-hash.sql output<TAB>pgflow release to upgrade from, or "-" for a structure this command recognises
# but cannot upgrade. Measured on the cron database of each released
# image that shipped pgflow before the comment existed (ghcr.io/fluxo-kt/aza-pg:<tag>-single-node); re-check with
# `bun scripts/test/test-pgflow-upgrade.ts --write-legacy-hashes`. This set never grows: every newer install records
# its version in the schema comment. Images that shipped pgflow 0.13.x installed an incomplete upstream schema (no
# pgflow.worker_functions, yet later columns present): no point in the migration history matches it, and replaying
# from any of them fails or ends different from a fresh install, so those databases are refused unchanged.
